verdict.rationale: Railway's own homepage features a customer testimonial saying Railway allows hard spending limits, so the capability is attributed directly to the product. However, it is a single thin mention with no first-party documentation of how limits are configured or enforced. Usage alerts (docs-9) are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing how to set hard limits, what happens when a limit is hit (e.g. services stopped or paused), per-project versus workspace scope, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs

citations.quote: really gotta commend @Railway for allowing hard spending limits, I have never, ever seen this with any cloud provider.
